theme_archetype.name: Swiss & High-Contrast (Brutalist Edge)
theme_archetype.rationale: Perfect for the music/band industry—combines the raw, edgy aesthetic of rock (high contrast, brutalist elements) with the precise, trustworthy functionality required for an e-commerce and SaaS platform.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none font-normal

grid_strategy.dashboard: Strict bento grid. 1px borders (border-white/15) separating panels. Use h-full to stretch components.
grid_strategy.storefront: Asymmetrical masonry or brutalist stacked grid for products. Massive imagery.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-wider hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-wider hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors duration-200

inputs.base: bg-transparent border border-white/20 rounded-none text-white focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#FF3B30] focus-visible:border-[#FF3B30] focus-visible:ring-offset-0

badges.base: uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-none border

navigation.header: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#0A0A0A]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10

motion_interactions.hover: Crisp, instantaneous color inversions or hard shadows. Avoid slow soft fades.
motion_interactions.marquee: Use an 'Editorial Ribbon' or 'Kinetic Texture' (massive outline text running in the background) for the storefront landing page.

icons.style: Duotone or bold weights to match the chunky typography.

images.description: Energetic rock band performance with striking stage lights.
Crowd with hands up at a concert.
Man wearing a black crew-neck t-shirt.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against #0A0A0A meets APCA standards. Use text-white for primary text and text-zinc-300 for secondary.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible 1px solid #FF3B30 focus outline.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Theme + Brutalist aesthetic (Archetype 4). No rounded corners (rounded-none).
Use Anton for all main headings (H1, H2) and Chivo for body text and dashboards.
Implement Shadcn UI but override all default radiuses to 0 (rounded-none) and borders to white/15.
The band public storefronts (/bands/:slug) should feel like a concert poster: massive headings, high contrast, immersive.
The Dashboards (Band, Printer, Super Admin) must be strictly functional: dark bento grids, no fluff, high data density.
For the customization canvas (Lumise style), implement a dark, pro-tool UI (similar to Figma) with Phosphor icons.
Do NOT use purple, teal, or generic AI gradients. Use pure #FF3B30 (Signal Red) as the sole accent color.
Inject fonts correctly into index.css via standard @import or link tag in index.html.
Use Pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing/storefront layouts; heavily customize Shadcn for complex forms/tables.
